{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for new customers reached by paid search
filtered_df = sales_df[
    (sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & 
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')
]

# Calculate the fraction who converted
total_new_paid_search = filtered_df.shape[0]
converted_new_paid_search = filtered_df['converted'].sum()

# Fraction converted
fraction_converted = converted_new_paid_search / total_new_paid_search

# Output
fraction_converted, total_new_paid_search, converted_new_paid_search"}
